working_version_lock.instruction: Treat the current production deployment as the rollback-safe checkpoint until exact repository, deployment ID, and production commit are identified.

lessons_learned: Deployment environment variables must be verified in Vercel and cannot be inferred from Supabase project health.
Password recovery requires both approved Supabase redirect URLs and an application-side update-password route.
Restart testing exposes cached provider and runtime-state defects.
Cross-device reproduction separates browser-local failures from server-side failures.
Ollama success proves local-device reachability for the tested session and does not prove universal hosted availability.
Partial success must be checkpointed before additional remediation.
Manual user clicking does not replace automated provider and navigation validation.
Every governed task requires a closeout receipt before completion.
